full.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of auricular cartilage from the ear, stained with H&E. It shows a localized cystic space within the cartilage matrix devoid of an epithelial lining. The findings are characteristic of a pseudocyst of the auricle, which develops as a non-inflammatory accumulation of fluid within the cartilage.
